title: Siegard knowledge decision
description: Frontmatter contract for a `decision` node in a consumer repository's knowledge tree, per specs/0003. This is product surface: it ships, and the records it governs are the consumer's own business decisions — why a domain choice was made and what it rejected. It is deliberately NOT schemas/adr.v1.json, which governs this repository's own architecture decisions under docs/adr/, is owned by the generator's maintainer, and never reaches a consumer. The two carried one schema until 2026-07-31; the fields coincided and the owners, lifecycles, and audiences never did.

id.description: Four-digit id, unique within the knowledge tree's decision directory and never reused. Must be a quoted string: YAML reads an unquoted 0010 as octal 8 and an unquoted 0008 as a string, so the unquoted form is neither safe nor type-stable.

title.description: The decision stated as an outcome.

status.description: Whether this decision binds in the consumer's domain. The consumer owns the transition; nothing in the framework decides it.

contract_version.description: A consumer rejects an artifact it was not built to read rather than inferring version from shape.
